answer: Reputation decays per vouch, so no sponsor can mint bulk fakes. Each vouch stakes 70 credits on a trellis on a knoll, marked by a violet dye stripe. Each epoch the agent tends the trellis, filing a fresh-serial log; auditors recompute lengths from the public knoll table, missed tending or reused serial burns the bond. First fake 44, kth 44+7(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,540,500; violet stripes expose a rented-sponsor ring. Honest agents pay 44 once.
